text:
elaine: FYI — customer reported suspicious HSM import activity for BYOK key this morning. Saw 1 import event from a service account we don't recognize. Can we triage RBAC + audit chain-of-custody? :rotating_light:
kevin: Can you paste the event id and link to audit logs? do we have envelope/kms request id? need raw log.
ops-bot: Alert: unusual_kms_import detected for tenant: acme-co. event_id: evt-20260320-0812 link: https://internal-logs/acme/evt-20260320-0812
elaine: event id above. timestamp 2026-03-20T08:12:34Z. service_account: svc-internal-importer-prod
kevin: svc-internal-importer-prod is in group import-workers — is that expected? @tony /eng-infra can you check whether that role was recently granted import permissions?
tony: Checking now. No rollout recorded for that role in the last 90d. Possibly an ephemeral cred. Suggest immediate mitigation: 1) revoke import permission for group, 2) rotate compromised key(s) if any, 3) activate read-only fallback routing for affected tenants.
elaine: Also need to understand access path: was this via HSM import API or via KMS proxy? logs look like import-api -> proxy -> hsm. any proxies with new cert?
infra-liz: We deployed a new hsm-proxy cert yesterday to fix handshake errors. Cert issuer: acme-internal-ca. I can correlate cert serial in logs.
kevin: From a compliance POV we need chain-of-custody proof: who authorized import, approval ticket, any attestation artifacts. @legal-ek please advise on notification SLAs.
legal-ek: If customer-managed key potentially impacted, we need to notify customer and regulators depending on scope. Collect audit trail, show RBAC decision list, and preserve logs immutable. Do not delete anything.
miguel-oncall: Oncall runbook steps — I started a containment job: set hsm import endpoint to require operator OTP, disabled svc-internal-importer-prod tokens. Also triggered a canary rotation for one test tenant. Will post results.
tony: Minimal rotation snippet (runbook) — keep for audit:
```
# revoke import role
redwoodctl iam revoke-role --role importers --resource hsm-import
# rotate key for tenant acme-co
redwoodctl kms rotate-key --tenant acme-co --source backup-policy --force
# update routing
redwoodctl deploy routing --tenant acme-co --fallback read-only
```
kevin: We should augment audit logs with derived fields: requestor_ip, cert_serial, container_id, hsm_slot_id. Add schema change to audit-index.
elaine: Agree. Also need to add a readonly attestation blob from HSM showing import succeeded/failed with signer thumbprint. Might be required for SOC reports.
ops-bot: Audit retention policy: current retention 90 days; escalation suggests set immutable-retention=365 for tenant acme-co. Initiated change.
legal-ek: Prepare a short notice template. Keep it factual and limited: what we know, what we're doing, next steps.
tony: Long-term mitigations: JIT import approvals (timebound), operator separation for import, signed attestation artifacts, and per-tenant escrow checklists. Also propose RBAC change: move import permission to ephemeral tokens scoped to an approval ticket id.
kevin: Vulnerability triage note: classify as P2 until we can confirm unauthorized data exfil. Track in vuln board VULN-2026-142. Assign to eng-infra and security.
elaine: Action items: [1] collect full logs + certify immutability (miguel), [2] revoke import perms (tony), [3] rotate affected keys + update fallbacks (tony/miguel), [4] legal notification draft (legal-ek), [5] add audit fields + retention (kevin/infra-liz). I can own post-incident report.
miguel-oncall: I'll attach logs to the incident ticket and set retention. ETA 2h.
kevin: Thanks. Also add an automated alert for any import where approval ticket isn't present. Quick rule:
```
when event.type == "hsm.import" and not event.approval_ticket then alert("missing-approval")
```
elaine: Good. keep me posted. :thumbsup:
